items.issue: The striped-shirt shot likely comes from an unlocated longer session, but no processed parent-stream match was found.
items.disposition: Keep as new only relative to the current corpus and re-run dedup when the parent stream appears.

items.issue: The clip says women ultimately prefer one type of man and discounts their negative evaluations.

items.issue: The ending claims any trivial behavior becomes attractive once a person has selfhood.
